lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Launch and planning: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The learner reads short plain-language descriptions of all five pathways, then sorts them against their own real interests and strengths rather than against which pathway sounds most impressive or most common in their household.
safetyNotes: This lesson is a written sorting and reflection exercise only; no contact with any outside person or organization is required to complete it.
materials: learner-local: the provided five-pathway description sheet

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Did any pathway end up in a different category than you expected before you started this lesson? What changed your mind?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Fit-based reasoning: Most sorting reasons name a specific interest or strength of the learner's own, for both categories. | Completeness of the sort: All five pathways are sorted with at least brief reasoning for each. | Self-awareness in reflection: Reflection names a specific pathway that moved categories and what caused the change. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner interview themselves in writing by listing one more pathway-relevant strength or interest not already mentioned, and explain which single pathway from the 'worth investigating further' list it most strengthens.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper or notes app

localMaterials.label: the provided five-pathway description sheet
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner reads short plain-language descriptions of all five pathways, then sorts them against their own real interests and strengths rather than against which pathway sounds most impressive or most common in their household.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work decision or action.
Model move 2: Before sorting anything, write down what you already believe about each pathway, even if you're not sure it's accurate.
Model move 3: Read the five short pathway descriptions, then sort all five into 'worth investigating further' or 'not a fit right now' based on your own interests and strengths.

Model check: Fit-based reasoning: Most sorting reasons name a specific interest or strength of the learner's own, for both categories. | Completeness of the sort: All five pathways are sorted with at least brief reasoning for each. | Self-awareness in reflection: Reflection names a specific pathway that moved categories and what caused the change.

resources.title: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner reads short plain-language descriptions of all five pathways, then sorts them against their own real interests and strengths rather than against which pathway sounds most impressive or most common in their household.
Coach direction: Before sorting anything, write down what you already believe about each pathway, even if you're not sure it's accurate.

Learner prompt: Of the five pathways (college, trade, apprenticeship, military, direct work), which one do you currently know the least about, and what is your best guess at what it actually involves day to day?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Read the five short pathway descriptions, then sort all five into 'worth investigating further' or 'not a fit right now' based on your own interests and strengths.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I sorted all five pathways into one of the two categories, and none are left unsorted.
Response 2 (t2-p2): For each pathway you placed in 'worth investigating further,' name one specific interest or strength of yours that connects to it.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Did any pathway end up in a different category than you expected before you started this lesson? What changed your mind?

Success checks: Fit-based reasoning: Most sorting reasons name a specific interest or strength of the learner's own, for both categories. | Completeness of the sort: All five pathways are sorted with at least brief reasoning for each. | Self-awareness in reflection: Reflection names a specific pathway that moved categories and what caused the change.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Fit-based reasoning: Most sorting reasons name a specific interest or strength of the learner's own, for both categories. | Completeness of the sort: All five pathways are sorted with at least brief reasoning for each. | Self-awareness in reflection: Reflection names a specific pathway that moved categories and what caused the change..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Fit-based reasoning: Most sorting reasons name a specific interest or strength of the learner's own, for both categories. | Completeness of the sort: All five pathways are sorted with at least brief reasoning for each. | Self-awareness in reflection: Reflection names a specific pathway that moved categories and what caused the change.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u01-l01-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
